avoid_supplements.name: Ginseng (American & Asian)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive hypoglycemic effects; ginseng enhances insulin secretion and glucose uptake
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue ginseng or monitor blood glucose closely; may require glimepiride dose reduction

avoid_supplements.name: Fenugreek
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent hypoglycemic activity; increases insulin secretion and slows carbohydrate absorption
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consult prescriber before use if diabetes control is established

avoid_supplements.name: Garlic (concentrated/supplement)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Significant hypoglycemic effects; allicin enhances insulin secretion
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose garlic supplements; monitor blood glucose if used

caution_supplements.name: Chromium
caution_supplements.mechanism: May enhance insulin sensitivity and glucose metabolism, potentially augmenting hypoglycemic effect
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose regularly; dose adjustment may be needed with high-dose chromium (>200 mcg daily)

caution_supplements.name: Bilberry
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild hypoglycemic properties; anthocyanins may improve glucose control
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution and monitor blood glucose; generally well-tolerated at dietary doses

caution_supplements.name: Bitter Melon
caution_supplements.mechanism: Hypoglycemic polypeptide-p may enhance insulin secretion and glucose utilization
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose; maintain consistent intake if used regularly

avoid_foods.name: High glycemic index foods (refined sugars, white bread, glucose drinks)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Rapid glucose absorption triggers excessive insulin secretion via glimepiride, risking severe hypoglycemia
avoid_foods.action: Advise patient to consume low-glycemic foods; maintain consistent carbohydrate intake; educate on glycemic index

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (especially on empty stomach)
caution_foods.mechanism: Alcohol impairs hepatic gluconeogenesis and enhances glimepiride hypoglycemic effect; increases hypoglycemia risk
caution_foods.action: Limit alcohol consumption; avoid consuming alcohol without food; monitor blood glucose

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay gastric emptying and nutrient absorption, potentially altering glimepiride pharmacokinetics and glucose response timing
caution_foods.action: Take glimepiride consistently with meals; monitor postprandial glucose response

monitoring_notes: Monitor blood glucose regularly, especially when initiating or discontinuing supplements. Educate patients on hypoglycemia recognition and the importance of maintaining consistent meal timing and carbohydrate intake with this insulin secretagogue.
